headline: The invoice text layout is tidied up with no change to what customers see.
what_changed: Invoice text should look the same as before. The same amounts, symbols and totals are produced.
Money formatting now lives in one shared place, so every invoice amount is formatted the same way.
Currency symbols still work as before: dollars, euros and pounds show their symbol, and other currencies show their short code, such as CHF 12.00.
A small new automated check was added for the money formatting, covering dollars, euros and an unknown currency.
Internal change only: the line-item helper now needs the currency passed in. The only other code that uses invoice text does not call that helper directly, so nothing else breaks.
questions_for_developer: Did the full test suite pass on this branch, including the existing invoice text test? I only read the code and did not run anything.
Is there any other part of the product, such as a PDF export or an email, that builds invoice lines on its own and might rely on the old helper's behaviour?
good_news: The change is small and contained, and it only moves existing logic into one place.
The existing invoice text test covers the main output, and the amounts it checks match the old behaviour.
Rounding is handled the same way as before, so totals should not shift by a cent.
